msrs.name: IA32_TIME_STAMP_COUNTER
msrs.detail: The time-stamp counter rdtsc reads.
notes: On old processors a write sets only the low 32 bits and clears the high half; use IA32_TSC_ADJUST (0x3B) to move the TSC where it exists.

msrs.name: IA32_APIC_BASE
msrs.detail: Local APIC base address and mode.

fields.name: BASE
fields.desc: physical base of the xAPIC MMIO page (default 0xFEE00000); bits above MAXPHYADDR are reserved

notes: EXTD=1 with EN=0 is an invalid state (#GP). Leaving x2APIC mode needs a pass through EN=0, EXTD=0.

msrs.name: IA32_FEATURE_CONTROL
msrs.detail: VMX/SMX/SGX enables; set and locked by firmware.
notes: Firmware sets LOCK; writing a locked register raises #GP.

msrs.name: IA32_TSC_ADJUST
msrs.detail: Signed offset added to the TSC; writing the TSC adjusts it too.

msrs.name: IA32_SPEC_CTRL
msrs.detail: Speculation control.
notes: Newer processors define more bits; they are not marked reserved here.

msrs.name: IA32_PRED_CMD
msrs.detail: Write-only command register.

msrs.name: IA32_BIOS_SIGN_ID
msrs.detail: Microcode update signature: write 0, execute cpuid leaf 1, then read bits 63:32.

msrs.name: IA32_MPERF
msrs.detail: Maximum-performance clock count (CPUID.6:ECX[0]).

msrs.name: IA32_APERF
msrs.detail: Actual-performance clock count (CPUID.6:ECX[0]).

msrs.name: IA32_MTRRCAP
msrs.detail: MTRR capabilities.

msrs.name: IA32_FLUSH_CMD
msrs.detail: Write-only command register.

fields.name: L1D_FLUSH
fields.desc: write back and invalidate the L1 data cache

msrs.name: IA32_SYSENTER_CS
msrs.detail: Ring-0 code selector for sysenter; SS = CS + 8, sysexit uses CS + 16 / + 24 (+ 32 / + 40 for 64-bit).

msrs.name: IA32_SYSENTER_ESP
msrs.detail: Ring-0 stack pointer loaded by sysenter.

msrs.name: IA32_SYSENTER_EIP
msrs.detail: Ring-0 entry point loaded by sysenter.

msrs.name: IA32_MISC_ENABLE
msrs.detail: Miscellaneous feature enables (Pentium 4 and later).

fields.name: LIMIT_CPUID
fields.desc: limit CPUID maximum leaf to 2 (set by some BIOSes for old OSes: hides leaves 4 and up)

fields.name: XD_DIS
fields.desc: execute-disable disabled: hides EFER.NXE and CPUID NX

notes: Many other bits are model-specific; read-modify-write it.

msrs.name: IA32_DEBUGCTL
msrs.detail: Debug control: last-branch record and branch trace.
notes: Intel layout. AMD defines bits 0-1 the same and bits 2-5 as performance-monitor pin control; bits 6 and up are Intel-only.

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_PHYSBASE{n}
msrs.detail: Variable-range MTRR base; pairs with PHYSMASK{n} at the next index. Only MTRRCAP.VCNT pairs exist.

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_PHYSMASK{n}
msrs.detail: Variable-range MTRR mask; pairs with PHYSBASE{n} at the previous index.

fields.name: PHYSMASK
fields.desc: mask: an address matches when (addr & mask) == (base & mask)

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_FIX64K_00000
msrs.detail: Fixed-range MTRR: eight 64 KiB ranges from 0x00000 to 0x7FFFF, one type byte each.

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_FIX16K_80000
msrs.detail: Fixed-range MTRR: eight 16 KiB ranges from 0x80000 to 0x9FFFF.

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_FIX16K_A0000
msrs.detail: Fixed-range MTRR: eight 16 KiB ranges from 0xA0000 to 0xBFFFF (legacy VGA).

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_FIX4K_C0000
msrs.detail: Fixed-range MTRR: eight 4 KiB ranges from 0xC0000.

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_FIX4K_C8000
msrs.detail: Fixed-range MTRR: eight 4 KiB ranges from 0xC8000.

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_FIX4K_D0000
msrs.detail: Fixed-range MTRR: eight 4 KiB ranges from 0xD0000.

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_FIX4K_D8000
msrs.detail: Fixed-range MTRR: eight 4 KiB ranges from 0xD8000.

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_FIX4K_E0000
msrs.detail: Fixed-range MTRR: eight 4 KiB ranges from 0xE0000.

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_FIX4K_E8000
msrs.detail: Fixed-range MTRR: eight 4 KiB ranges from 0xE8000.

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_FIX4K_F0000
msrs.detail: Fixed-range MTRR: eight 4 KiB ranges from 0xF0000.

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_FIX4K_F8000
msrs.detail: Fixed-range MTRR: eight 4 KiB ranges from 0xF8000.

msrs.name: IA32_PAT
msrs.detail: Page attribute table: the memory type each PAT/PCD/PWT combination in a page table entry selects. Power-on value 0x0007040600070406 (WB, WT, UC-, UC repeated).
notes: Entry index = PAT*4 + PCD*2 + PWT from the page table entry. Types 2 and 3 are reserved and fault.

msrs.name: IA32_MTRR_DEF_TYPE
msrs.detail: Default memory type and MTRR enables.

fields.name: TYPE
fields.desc: memory type for addresses no MTRR covers

msrs.name: IA32_TSC_DEADLINE
msrs.detail: Local APIC timer deadline in TSC-deadline mode (CPUID.1:ECX.TSC_Deadline).

msrs.name: x2APIC register
msrs.detail: x2APIC MSR space: MSR 0x800 + (xAPIC MMIO offset >> 4). Only valid with IA32_APIC_BASE.EXTD set; otherwise #GP.
notes: x2APIC MSR writes are not serializing: fence before an ICR write that depends on earlier stores.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_APICID
msrs.detail: 32-bit x2APIC ID.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_VERSION
msrs.detail: Version (bits 7:0), max LVT entry (23:16), EOI-broadcast suppression (24).

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_TPR
msrs.detail: Task priority.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_PPR
msrs.detail: Processor priority.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_EOI
msrs.detail: End of interrupt: write 0 (a non-zero value raises #GP).

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_LDR
msrs.detail: Logical destination (read-only in x2APIC mode).

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_SIVR
msrs.detail: Spurious interrupt vector.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_ISR{n}
msrs.detail: In-service register, bits 32n+31:32n.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_TMR{n}
msrs.detail: Trigger mode register, bits 32n+31:32n.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_IRR{n}
msrs.detail: Interrupt request register, bits 32n+31:32n.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_ESR
msrs.detail: Error status; write 0 before reading.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_LVT_CMCI
msrs.detail: LVT corrected machine check interrupt.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_ICR
msrs.detail: Interrupt command register, one 64-bit write sends the IPI.
notes: No delivery-status bit in x2APIC mode: the write itself sends.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_LVT_TIMER
msrs.detail: LVT timer: vector 7:0, mask 16, mode 18:17 (one-shot, periodic, TSC-deadline).

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_LVT_THERMAL
msrs.detail: LVT thermal sensor.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_LVT_PMI
msrs.detail: LVT performance monitoring counters.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_LVT_LINT0
msrs.detail: LVT LINT0 (ExtINT from the 8259 on the BSP).

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_LVT_LINT1
msrs.detail: LVT LINT1 (NMI).

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_LVT_ERROR
msrs.detail: LVT error.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_INIT_COUNT
msrs.detail: Timer initial count.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_CUR_COUNT
msrs.detail: Timer current count.

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_DIV_CONF
msrs.detail: Timer divide configuration (bits 3, 1:0).

msrs.name: IA32_X2APIC_SELF_IPI
msrs.detail: Self IPI: write the vector in bits 7:0.

msrs.name: IA32_XSS
msrs.detail: Supervisor state components for xsaves/xrstors; bit layout as XCR0 (PT 8, PASID 10, CET_U 11, CET_S 12, HDC 13, UINTR 14, LBR 15, HWP 16). Exists when CPUID.(0xD,1):EAX[3].

msrs.name: IA32_EFER
msrs.detail: Extended feature enable register.

fields.name: LME
fields.desc: long mode enable (takes effect when CR0.PG is set)

fields.name: LMA
fields.desc: long mode active (set by the CPU)

fields.name: NXE
fields.desc: no-execute enable: bit 63 of page table entries

fields.name: LMSLE
fields.desc: long mode segment limit enable (AMD, dropped on Zen 3 and later)

notes: Changing LME while CR0.PG is set raises #GP: enable PAE and load CR3, set LME, then set CR0.PG.
AMD defines further bits above 15 on recent parts; they are not checked.

msrs.name: IA32_STAR
msrs.detail: syscall/sysret segment bases.

fields.name: SYSRET_CS
fields.desc: user selector base: sysret loads CS = this + 16 (64-bit) or this (32-bit), SS = this + 8

msrs.name: IA32_LSTAR
msrs.detail: 64-bit syscall target RIP; must be canonical (#GP otherwise).

msrs.name: IA32_CSTAR
msrs.detail: Compatibility-mode syscall target RIP (AMD; Intel never uses it).

msrs.name: IA32_FMASK
msrs.detail: RFLAGS bits cleared by syscall.

msrs.name: IA32_FS_BASE
msrs.detail: FS segment base in 64-bit mode; must be canonical.

msrs.name: IA32_GS_BASE
msrs.detail: GS segment base in 64-bit mode; must be canonical.

msrs.name: IA32_KERNEL_GS_BASE
msrs.detail: Value swapgs exchanges with GS_BASE; must be canonical.

msrs.name: IA32_TSC_AUX
msrs.detail: Value rdtscp and rdpid return (OSes store the CPU number here).

msrs.name: SYSCFG
msrs.detail: AMD system configuration.

fields.name: MtrrFixDramModEn
fields.desc: RdDram/WrDram bits of the fixed MTRRs are writable

fields.name: MtrrVarDramEn
fields.desc: TOP_MEM and I/O range registers enable

fields.name: Tom2ForceMemTypeWB
fields.desc: memory between 4 GiB and TOP_MEM2 is WB by default

fields.name: MemEncryptionModEn
fields.desc: SME: C-bit in page tables enabled

msrs.confidence: bit positions 18-23 from the AMD APM / BKDG; older BKDGs list further model-specific bits below 18
notes: MtrrFixDramModEn must be cleared again after editing the fixed MTRRs' RdDram/WrDram bits.

msrs.name: TOP_MEM
msrs.detail: Top of DRAM below 4 GiB (bits 47:23 meaningful).

msrs.name: TOP_MEM2
msrs.detail: Top of DRAM above 4 GiB (bits 47:23 meaningful).

msrs.name: VM_CR
msrs.detail: SVM control.

msrs.name: VM_HSAVE_PA
msrs.detail: Physical address of the 4 KiB host save area vmrun uses.
notes: Must be 4 KiB aligned; the low 12 bits are reserved.
